primitives.name: StateSet
primitives.statement: There is a set S of states.

primitives.name: ProcessSet
primitives.statement: There is a set H of processes.

primitives.name: SourceTarget
primitives.statement: Each process has source and target maps.
primitives.operational_definition: Two functions from H to S.

primitives.name: PartialComposition
primitives.statement: Some composable process pairs have a composition result.
primitives.operational_definition: A partial function on ordered process pairs.

definitions.name: InducedRelation
definitions.statement: xRy iff some process has source x and target y.

definitions.name: RelationProjection
definitions.statement: Maps a process system to its induced existence relation.

claims.statement: Two process systems can have identical states, processes, source/target maps, and induced relation while having distinct composition laws.
There is no universal reconstruction of unrestricted composition laws from induced relation alone.
A relation-only representation cannot distinguish composition variants sharing the same induced edge relation.
Some composition structure may be derivable from weaker sequential or rewrite constraints without assuming full composition primitively.

observables.name: CompositionOutcome
observables.definition: The result assigned to a composable ordered process pair.

falsifiers.condition: Provide a relation-only reconstruction that uniquely recovers both distinct witness composition laws.

metadata.purpose: Test whether composition contains information absent from directed relation projection.
